included: Original baseline/improved/final frozen source inputs and manifests; original experiment receipts, Playwright/Vitest JSON, stdout logs, Canonical Logs and error context; early and final acceptance JSON; current and baseline collection JSON; assertion inventory; reporter-failure probe records.
notIncluded: Browser profiles, shared node_modules, generated Vite outputs, binary trace.zip and external PNG/HTML artifacts remain local only under .dev and are not delivered by this git commit. Embedded JSON attachments are preserved. Previous real-model raw exports are not included.
restore: In a fresh checkout only, extract at repository root. Install the dependencies matching each frozen package-lock.json; create each source/node_modules symlink to those installed dependencies. Use the current root audit-tests.mjs with the matching SURFWAX_AUDIT_STAGE (unset for baseline). Do not extract over an existing audit stage.
provenance: The three root collection JSON files were rewritten by the independent review on 2026-11-05 and subsequently regenerated after guard fixes; they are current collections, not original immutable records. Baseline collection files and original experiment/acceptance results were not overwritten.
